notes.title: Major Update - New Meta Progression And More
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/482438dcd0cc12366034cae1ee4a961256df76ee.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Howdy, Gunslingers![/b][/h3][p]The number one thing you asked for is finally in the game. And it’s a big deal. Like, T-Rex-sized.[/p][p]Meta progression has stomped into Dino Path Trail and it’s changing everything. From now on, every run helps you grow. Win or lose, you’ll walk away stronger, with permanent rewards that unlock tools, upgrades, shortcuts, and cool stuff back at the Hub.[/p][p]Frustrated by starting from scratch after every defeat? Not anymore. This system makes bouncing back way smoother. You’ll kick off new runs with better gear, more options, and a real sense of progress.[/p][p]With tons of long-term goals to chase, this update adds a big dose of strategy and replayability. Ready to see what’s new?[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ Hub Upgrades and Permanent Unlocks[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tool System Overhaul
[/b]Tools can now be permanently unlocked in the Hub. Start runs with your favorite gear and jump right into the action. Stone shovel? Child’s play. Let’s get serious.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Base Camp Construction
[/b]Use Dino Coins to unlock and upgrade your crafting tables. Skip the slow stuff and go straight for the spicy builds.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🏕️ Hub Growth Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Buff Gate Upgrades
[/b]More choices, more rerolls, and more ways to start strong. The Buff Gate just got buffed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scavenger Stands
[/b]She's back, she’s loud, and now she’s selling your old loot. Expand her market and grab powerful gear from past runs at a discount.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]💀 Bounty Hunter System[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Difficulty, Your Way
[/b]Take on tougher challenges with escalating difficulty levels and juicy rewards. Finish a run to unlock the next tier and keep climbing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom Modifiers
[/b]Every level adds new twists. Hungry faster? Ghost dinos? Random lightning? Oh yes. It’s chaos and it’s glorious.[/p][/*][*][p][b]High Risk, High Reward
[/b]Crank up the pain and earn extra Dino Coins while you're at it. Get serious or go extinct.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🗺️ Quality of Life and Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Source Icons added to the minimap[/b] so you can find what you need without wandering like a lost raptor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased FoV on the minimap[/b] for better visibility and planning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maps are now slightly smaller[/b] to cut down on running and ramp up the action.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Day cycle is longer[/b], so there’s more time to explore before the sun goes down.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fewer enemies spawn in each map[/b], making things feel less like a mob rush and more like a survival challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Difficulty now ramps up faster[/b], keeping the pressure high and rewarding efficient players.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📈 Why This Changes Everything[/b][/h3][p]You asked for it. We wanted it. And now it’s here.
Meta progression makes every run matter. Even if it ends in disaster, you still get stronger, smarter, and more prepared for the next.[/p][p]Your tools evolve. Your Hub expands. Your strategy deepens. And your chances of survival? Well... let’s just say they won't improve.[/p][p][/p][p]Jump back in and start carving out your legacy.
What will you unlock first? What challenge level will you dare to face?[/p][p][/p][p][i]🦴 See you back on the trail![/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update #2: Fixes & Tweaks
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/b79edeee631624f3201470dabd1414dc9acb6649.png[/img]

[b]Howdy, Gunslingers![/b]

We’re back with our second update since launch - and it’s another step toward making your journey through Dino Path Trail smoother, meaner, and fairer.

Massive thanks to everyone who’s been playing, surviving, breaking the game, and telling us about it. We seriously read everything - and your feedback has been a huge driver for this patch.

If you’ve got more thoughts, bugs, or just want to shoot the breeze, drop by our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ErZJ7FNh8g]Discord[/url] or post right here on Steam. We’re listening ːccheartː

[h2]🛠️ Here’s what’s changed in this update:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed UIs of buttons, hints, tutorial, and quests that had overlapping text
[*] Lowered Raptors family evasion chance
[*] Added more explanatory descriptions to statuses, dinosaur blessings, and explosives
[*] Changed “Stun” status to remove evasion
[*] Changed “Slow” status to decrease evasion instead of decreasing the drawing and shooting speed of weapons
[*] Panacea now correctly removes all Debuffs
[*] Increased time needed for bounty hunters to spawn
[*] The following mods will now work on all shots:
- Explosive Bullets
- Hunter Bullets
- Penetrating Bullets
- Ricocheting Bullets
- Thunder Bullets
- Fragmenting Bullets
[*] Fixed a bug that would make the second boss disappear and never reappear
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing users from moving after being stunned
[*] Fixed a bug that would block users using the controller from exiting menus under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug on Questlog not showing/hiding properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent users from completing quests taken from Grim Claws during exploration
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Grim Claws gather materials quest from showing the current progress.
[*] Fixed a bug that was locking the boss entrance sequences while reloading a weapon
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the loading screen music from fading out under certain circumstances
[/list]

[b]Thanks again for sticking with us.
More updates are on the way - and the trail’s only getting wilder ❤️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/7074a79d4aa44bab0f8e4ed74fe890f1f9bb94ec.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #1: Fixes, Tweaks, and More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/9a2644d12046539f100129c74fc35584fd268f90.png[/img]

[b]Howdy, Gunslingers![/b]

Huge thanks to everyone who's been playing, dying, surviving, and sharing feedback on the full release of Dino Path Trail. We read everything, and every report helps us make the game better. Your feedback’s been a huge help - please feel free to share more on [url=https://discord.com/invite/ErZJ7FNh8g]Discord[/url] or right here on Steam. We’re checking everything ːccheartː

[b]Today we’re rolling out our first patch[/b] - a solid batch of bug fixes, tweaks, and polish to make your survival smoother, nastier (for the dinos), and just a little more fair (for you… most of the time) 🦖

[h2]🛠️ Here’s what’s changed in this update:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following achievements are now properly unlockable: First Steps, Poison for Everybody, Lucky Cowgirl, Fire and Flames, Blood Everywhere, Bulletproof vest!, The Old Team.
[*] Removed a bug that allowed you to craft higher-tier items without having built the required worktable level.
[*] Removed a bug that would cause players to spawn in the first exploration map without weapons/throwables.
[*] The game is now warning you when it is saving. You will also be warned when quitting the game. 
[i](We are also working on a possible way to allow you to manually save in the exploration maps and regenerate them in one of the future updates)[/i]
[*] Added an option to easily switch display from the Graphics Settings.
[*] Fixed a bug that was allowing you to die in the tutorial using explosives.
[*] Fixed a bug that was affecting your max health negatively when leaving the tutorial map and starting your first run.
[*] Bounty Hunter and Scavenger are now properly triggering their services when you build their homes in the hub. 
[i](They will also give you an introductory dialogue where they explain what they do)[/i]
[*] Fixed a visual bug related to the Bug Report tool not closing properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that was allowing you to craft and possess more than 1 mod of the same type, which was consuming your materials and sending the crafted mod into oblivion. 
[i](This bug was probably also related to weapons upgrades doing the same, but we are still tracking this bug)[/i]
[*] Fixed the items acquired notification getting stuck on the left of the screen in some situations.
[*] Interacting too soon with the chest to pick the mod in the tutorial is no longer possible and will prevent you from getting stuck there.
[*] Fixed a bug that was spawning only the scavenger in NPC tiles.
[*] Fixed the second part of the tutorial to properly trigger combat music.
[*] Fixed a bug that was not visually updating the bounty after moving to a new map.
[*] Lowered prices of shops inside and outside run.
[*] Decreased “Slow” status effect on the drawing and shooting speed of weapons.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the smelter to smelt the wrong amount of items.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused items to be consumed twice when using a two handed weapon.
[*] Increased the delay between money floating texts.
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing the loading screen to disappear at the end of the loading process.
[/list]
[b]Thank you for all your support - we love you all ❤️
See you on the trail![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/0853b7d1c0dae3f8834cc9c21b23be9ba58ceb06.png[/img]

notes.title: 🦖New Demo Update is Live🦖
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/b5747a4731fc742f5c0f0bda9652dfc4cac68d25.png[/img]

[b]Howdy y'all![/b]

We just rolled out a new update for the Dino Path Trail demo ːsteamsaltyː

[b]The full game is launching very soon - on May 9th.[/b]
[i]We’re beyond excited that after more than three years of work, the game will finally be in your hands.[/i]

[b]Patch Notes for the Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tuned down muddy butch attack frequency to allow more time for the player to retaliate
[*] Increased visual clarity of the travel map to allow user to plan their travels better
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing the camera to render the scene completely black
[*] Now, all buffs to the player's stats are correctly reflected in the player's backpack
[*] Improved the player backpack stat section to update in real time when switching equipment
[*] Fixed Blessings not correctly triggering on received hits under certain circumstances
[*] Reworked the Quick and Precise statuses to be more in line with other statuses
[*] Improved dialogue quality, along with a better introduction to the story
[*] Added status immunity on tougher enemies to better reflect the difficulty change at different steps of Bounty
[*] Added storage access while in the shop to allow players more “room” to buy items
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing items to float when spawned from destroyed objects
[*] Reduced the possibility for procedurally spawned objects to appear in unreachable spots
[*] Optimized loading times to be faster, especially when switching between zones
[/list]

[i]Thank you for all your support - we love you all! ❤️[/i]

[b]See you on the trail![/b]

notes.title: Dino Path Trail Demo - New Update is Live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44362705/a5706897ebe1e7fb19d0ca24e2f1d6ae2cb3d33f.jpg[/img]

[b]Howdy, Gunslingers![/b]

First and foremost, we’d like to thank everyone who has played and shared their feedback on Dino Path Trail Demo! We truly appreciate it. Your input helps us shape the game, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https://discord.com/invite/ErZJ7FNh8g]Discord [/url] and Steam! ːccheartː

[b]Today, we're releasing the new update with another round of fixes and improvements[/b] to make your dino-hunting, gun-slinging, and survival-roguing experience smoother, faster, and deadlier (for your enemies, not you… hopefully). 🦖

[i]Here’s what’s changed in this update:[/i]

[h2]🛠️ Major Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked Difficulty Scaling:[/b] Adjusted difficulty progression to feel more balanced across different runs. Less unfair spikes, more "I should have dodged that!" moments.
[*] [b]Faster, More Responsive Weapons:[/b] Every weapon now feels snappier and quicker to use, making combat more fluid and satisfying.
[*] [b]Improved Mouse & Keyboard Interaction:[/b] You can now interact with close objects without having to "aim" at them. Smooth and simple!
[*] [b]New Game Shortcut:[/b] You can now start a new run directly from the end-game screen. Because who needs a break, right?
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Minor Fixes & Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Swarm Tactics Upgrade:[/b] Enemies now attack with more widened timing when ganging up on you. Stay sharp, Gunslinger!
[*] [b]More Lichens![/b] Increased spawn rate, so go gather them like a true survivalist.
[*] [b]Weapon Wheel Bug Fixed:[/b] If you were struggling to equip weapons properly with mouse & keyboard, that’s now fixed.
[*] [b]Craft Confirmation Prompt Added:[/b] Closing the crafting interface with pending crafts will now ask for confirmation instead of making you regret your life choices.
[*] [b]Inventory Full Bug Squashed:[/b] Items will no longer mysteriously disappear when your inventory is full. No more void-eating your loot!
[*] [b]Stun Fix:[/b] Now all enemies can be properly stunned. Time to test your crowd control skills.
[*] [b]Chain-Crafting Now Works Properly:[/b] Fixed an issue where items weren’t being consumed correctly when crafting multiple times in a row.
[*] [b]Molotov Nerfed:[/b] The burning area duration has been reduced. Less standing in fire, more actual fighting.
[*] [b]Shotgunner Enemy Damage Lowered:[/b] Getting blasted at close range is still painful, just... slightly less deadly now.
[/list]

🔥 That’s All for Now!
Another patch, another batch of fixes and improvements. Thanks for all your feedback, bug reports, and cowboy-dino chaos! Keep those six-shooters loaded and let us know how these updates feel!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.17 is Live! Key Fixes and Improvements for Dino Path Trail Demo
notes.notes:
Howdy, Gunslingers!

Your [b]playtests, feedback, and bug reports[/b] have been absolute game-changers, and today, we’re rolling out our first patch based on everything you’ve shared with us!

Before diving into the details, a quick reminder:
💡 [b]Using the in-game Bug Report tool is crucial![/b] It sends us your [b]save file, current session log, and even the previous session log[/b], meaning if the game crashes or you restart, we can still access valuable info to track down the issue.
So, if your UI or game gets stuck, you can reload and send a report, to let us know what happened. We’ll check the logs and get to work!

[h2]🛠️ Major Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Blessings & Modifiers:[/b] Many effects that weren’t applying correctly to Lucy are now working as intended. (Daredevil Blessing was indeed a scam 😅 our bad)
[*] [b]Graphical Fixes:[/b] No more mysterious black bands on terrain and minimap for certain resolutions.
[*] [b]Difficulty Adjustment:[/b] Max difficulty has been slightly lowered. Enjoy the (temporary) mercy!
[*] [b]Improved Inventory Navigation:[/b] Mouse & Keyboard users will find it much easier to select and move items! This feature is still in testing tho, so it will probably be improved more with the following patches.
[*] [b]Lichens Visual Update:[/b] We’ve given the Lichens a little makeover! They’re no longer hiding in plain sight, making it much simpler to gather the resources for those much-needed healing items.
[*] [b]Rifle Rework:[/b] All rifles have been reworked, so now they actually feel like you’re shooting a classic Winchester, not a wet noodle.
[*] [b]Gamepad Disconnection Handling:[/b] If your controller disconnects, the game will pause and smoothly switch to Mouse & Keyboard after your current action is complete. Now you have time to rage-throw your controller before grabbing your trusty M&K.
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Minor Fixes & Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Quest Fixes:[/b] No more Grim Claws asking you to eliminate "0" bandits or dinosaurs.
It should also prevent the UI from disappearing, but let us know the result.
[*] [b]UI Anchoring:[/b] Like any wanted poster, floating UI elements are now properly pinned down.
[*] [b]Loading Screen Glitches:[/b] Possible fix for screens getting stuck when transitioning between menus.
This seems to happen rarely, but we've added a couple of logs to investigate further in case it isn't resolved. If your screen turns darker than Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon after returning to the main menu, please send us a bug report using the in-game tool.
[*] [b]Looting Fix:[/b] Some items were playing hard to get: gathering them didn’t give you anything! Well, no more! You’ll actually get the loot you deserve when you pick things up.
[*] [b]Tutorial Fixes:[/b] The Saltpit no longer self-destructs after gathering. it's not a secret message for James Bond, after all.
[*] [b]Hovering UI Issues:[/b] Fixed invisible elements blocking clicks.
There might be more sneaky ones lurking around! If your mouse starts acting weird, like not hovering or clicking properly because of some invisible force field, give us a shout!
[*] [b]Missing Strings & Localization:[/b] More missing texts have been found and resolved. Keep an eye out for any that remain!
[*] [b]Weapon SFX Tweaks:[/b] More Pew Pew Pew, less muffled gunfire.
[*] [b]Video Settings Adjustments:[/b] Better real-time adaptation when changing resolution/display.
Let us know if you see something strange happening (or not happening, lol).
[*] [b]Widescreen Resolutions Removed:[/b] Sorry ultra-wide folks, balancing the game for that view would be too time-consuming, so black bars it is!
[/list]
[h2]🚀 Features & Fixes moved to Backlog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]UI Scaling System:[/b] We’re working on an optional UI scaling feature for better accessibility (especially for Steam Deck players).
We’d rather not turn our game into a free eyeglasses giveaway with every purchase!
[*] [b]Aim Assist Improvements:[/b] We know it’s not always perfect, and we are discussing possible improvements about the aim assist system with controller for future updates after the core game is complete.
[/list]

[b]Thank you all for your amazing support[/b], this is just the beginning! Keep the bug reports and feedback coming, and [b]we’ll keep making Dino Path Trail even better[/b]!

[b]👉 Now go update, play, and let us know what you think! 🔥[/b]
